questions.e: The Dow rose more than 500 points, about 1%, to close above 52,000, leading the major indexes as investors rotated into value and health care stocks.
questions.q: On Tuesday, Oct 20, 2026, roughly how many points did the Dow Jones Industrial Average gain?

questions.e: Health care led all 11 S&P 500 sectors and hit a record, with Eli Lilly, UnitedHealth and Merck among the gainers. Energy lagged as oil eased from a five-month high.
questions.h: Drugmakers and insurers led the way.
questions.q: Which S&P 500 sector led the market on Oct 20, 2026 and hit a record high?

questions.e: GM beat profit estimates with adjusted EPS of $3.70, but shares slid about 7% on signs of higher commodity costs and lower truck sales. GM narrowed its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $12.75 to $13.75.
questions.h: A beat doesn't always mean a rally.
questions.q: How did General Motors shares react to GM's third-quarter report on Oct 20, 2026?

questions.e: 3M expanded its data-center partnership with Amazon, which included a warrant, and raised its full-year profit forecast after third-quarter adjusted EPS of $2.50 topped estimates.
questions.q: 3M shares rose about 5% on Oct 20, 2026 after it raised its profit forecast and expanded a data-center partnership with which company?

questions.e: Netflix reported Q3 revenue of about $12.87 billion, up roughly 12% from a year earlier, with a 34.6% operating margin. It forecast about $13.4 billion for Q4.
questions.h: Roughly a quarter of its full-year revenue of about $51 billion.
questions.q: Netflix reported third-quarter 2026 results after the close on Oct 20. About how much revenue did it report for the quarter?
